source.title: Owner's idea in chat, 2026-10-20: 15-minute displacement, all day: a candle that closes beyond the previous candle's wick AND whose body is at least 2x the previous candle's body, entered with it

entry.words: On 1-minute NQ candles, entries decided 09:45:01-10:00:00 ET only (the fifteen 1-minute candles 09:45-09:59): when a candle closes above the previous candle's high and its body is at least 2x the previous candle's body, go long at the close; below the previous low with a body at least 2x, go short.

taught: [chat 2026-10-20] no time window trade all day, lets use displacement, lets try 15 minute frame
[chat 2026-10-20] every time we close above the previous wicks candle and the candle body is 2x bigger than the previous candles body, then long, vice versa for shorts
[chat 2026-10-20] try 9:45-10am on 1 minute and 5 minute (this sheet: 1-minute, 2x, centre 1:0.5)
not_run: THE EXITS were not given: Claude used the house candle-break stop (the breaking candle's extreme, floored at 0.25 x ATR(14)) and a 1:0.5 target; the neighbours are 1:0.375 and 1:0.625.
THE WICK: a close strictly above the previous high (long) or strictly below the previous low (short).
THE BODY: |close - open| of the breaking candle >= 2 x |close - open| of the previous candle.
FLAT: every trade is flat by 15:58 ET (13:13 on half days); no trade is held past it.
THE CAP: none (the lane's 20 a pass); one position at a time inside a pass.
COSTS AND FILLS: the engine's own (1 tick of slippage, $4 a round turn, tick replay).

THE WINDOW 09:45-10:00 is the open layer's w_start 09:45:01 / w_end 10:00:01 (an entry decided at a 1-minute close from 09:46 (1m) or 09:50 (5m) to 10:00:00); the trade then runs to its stop, target or 15:58. The random control does not wait for the window (the lane's own limit).
